prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: one new Lv2 Gautama progression concept sprite for Starsector, transparent background.

Input roles:
Image1: original BASE Gautama, the identity, proportions, mounting layout and engine registration reference.
Image2: the user's SELECTED more mature Gautama form, which will be Lv3. This is the approved progression style. New image should bridge Image1 -> Image2.
Image3: native THREAT Fabricator, material and anatomical design-language reference only. It is a self-organizing machine with arthropod/crustacean-like hard shell structures.

Primary request: make a clearly developed LV2 form of Gautama, one meaningful evolutionary step beyond the base and a restrained step before the selected Lv3. Change structure, not just resolution, size, cracks or wear. Preserve Gautama's three familiar unequal hull masses, broad squat proportions, upper central keel, heavy left shoulder, open right-hand framework and lower central machinery in their original relative locations. Preserve the same engine outlet locations and general hull envelope so the existing collision and engine layout can be reused; actual size growth will be uniformly applied later at 1.2x. Do not bake a resize into the art.

Evolution anatomy: new growth consists of HARD articulated shell plating and overlapping rigid scutes, like an insect or shellfish exoskeleton expressed as THREAT machinery. Add a few stepped overlapping shell segments around the shoulder joints and central flank, shallow nested armor ridges on the existing keel and small hardened flanges supporting the existing open structures. Make the joins look articulated, crustacean-like and tightly interlocked, with dark recessed machinery visible between the pale shell pieces. Keep substantially more of the base's simple plates and open spaces than the mature Image2. Keep visible round mounting recesses readable and in the existing pattern. A small amount of structure may reshape edge details, but don't grow large new limbs, wings, spikes or a different body plan.

Style: match the selected Image2 and native Fabricator's modest low-contrast overhead 2D painted game-sprite look, muted weathered ivory/gray-green shell-metal, dark mechanical cavities and finely drawn spars. Dry, hard, segmented, jointed and load-bearing. Preserve asymmetry. No flesh, skin, muscles, veins, wet tissue, rubbery tubes, intestines, soft swollen blobs or melted/liquid bone. Do not turn the ship into a literal animal, crab, lobster, face or skull character.
Strict top-down orthographic camera, bow up. One intact ship, whole silhouette visible with transparent padding. Genuinely transparent background; no black fill, stars, text, labels, comparison panels, effects or flame plumes.
status: Concept masters only; original runtime geometry and art stay untouched.
